statements.chinese: 什么？Chandler！告诉他们！

statements.english: Well I mean , let me get the door first
statements.chinese: 好吧，我是说，让我先开门。

statements.english: Oh , hi ! No one
statements.chinese: 哦，你好！没人在。

statements.english: Why should Ben step aside ?
statements.chinese: 为什么Ben要让位？

statements.english: It was his audition in the first place !
statements.chinese: 这本来就是他的试镜！

statements.english: You-you just tagged along ! You're like the uh , tag-a-long dad
statements.chinese: 你——你只是跟着瞎掺和！你就像那个，呃，硬要凑热闹的老爸。

statements.english: At least I care about his feelings !
statements.chinese: 至少我还在乎他的感受！

statements.english: What ?!
statements.chinese: 什么？！

statements.english: Do you know how hard this is gonna be on him when he doesn't get it ?
statements.chinese: 你知道如果他得不到它，这对他会有多难吗？

statements.english: And why wouldn't he get it ?
statements.chinese: 他怎么会不明白呢？

statements.english: Oh , come on !
statements.chinese: 哎呀，别这样！

statements.english: Have you seen what my kid can do ?! Huh ?!
statements.chinese: 你看到我家孩子有多厉害了吗？！啊？！

statements.english: I mean he dials phones ! He-he-he eats tortilla chips !
statements.chinese: 我是说他拨电话！嘿-嘿-嘿还吃玉米片！

dials.definition: dial（第三人称单数）: 拨号

statements.english: He-he plays soccer with the cartoon tiger !
statements.chinese: 他-他和卡通老虎一起踢足球！

statements.english: Are you saying your kid eats soup better than my kid ?
statements.chinese: 你是说你家孩子喝汤比我家孩子厉害？

statements.english: You just give him a spoon baby !
statements.chinese: 宝贝，你就给他个勺子吧！

statements.english: Oh yeah ? I guess we'll just see !
statements.chinese: 哦是吗？那咱们走着瞧！

statements.english: Yeah ! Because this commercial belongs to me and Mitch !
statements.chinese: 没错！因为这条广告是属于我和Mitch的！

belongs.definition: belong（第三人称单数）: 属于

statements.english: You're kid's name is Raymond !
statements.chinese: 你孩子的名字是Raymond！

statements.english: Yeah ?! So's yours !
statements.chinese: 是吗？！你的也是！

statements.english: How did work go ?
statements.chinese: 工作进展如何？

did.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句

statements.english: Oh it was great !
statements.chinese: 哦，太棒了！

statements.english: It was great ! I went down there just like you said , y'know ?
statements.chinese: 太棒了！我就照你说的那样下去了，懂吧？

statements.english: And we talked business . Kim totally took my opinions
statements.chinese: 我们谈了生意上的事，Kim完全采纳了我的意见。

statements.english: You stink !
statements.chinese: 你真臭！

statements.english: Thanks !
statements.chinese: 谢谢！

statements.english: No , I'm-I'm serious !
statements.chinese: 不，我是认真的！

statements.english: Well-well that's because I went down there and they were all smoking
statements.chinese: 唉——那是因为我去了那边，发现他们全都在抽烟。

were.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去进行时

statements.english: This is actually the smell of success
statements.chinese: 这其实就是成功的味道。

statements.english: Okay , there's something different though–
statements.chinese: 不过，有件事倒是不同——

statements.english: Oh my God ! You smoked !
statements.chinese: 天啊！你居然抽烟了！

statements.english: I did not !
statements.chinese: 我没有！

statements.english: Yes you did !
statements.chinese: 没错，就是你！

statements.english: You look happy and sick ; you smoked !
statements.chinese: 你看起来又高兴又生病；你抽烟了！

statements.english: All right , fine ! But I had too ! I had to do it for my career !
statements.chinese: 好吧，行吧！但我必须这么做！为了我的事业，我不得不这样做！

had.definition: have（过去式）: 构成过去完成时

statements.english: I wish I had smoked for my career ..
statements.chinese: 我希望我抽烟是为了我的事业…

had.definition: have（过去分词）: 构成过去完成时

statements.english: That's so gross !
statements.chinese: 真恶心！

statements.english: No well , no it's not that bad , y'know ?
statements.chinese: 不，也没那么糟，你懂吧？

statements.english: I mean yeah , my tongue feels a little fuzzy
statements.chinese: 我是说，确实，我的舌头感觉有点麻麻的

feels.definition: feel（第三人称单数）: 感觉

statements.english: and these fingers sort of smell
statements.chinese: 这些手指闻起来有点怪味，

statements.english: I actually feel like I can throw up
statements.chinese: 我其实觉得我快要吐了。

statements.english: Okay , but you gotta push past this
statements.chinese: 好吧，但你必须克服这个障碍

statements.english: because it is about to get so good !
statements.chinese: 因为好戏即将上演！

statements.english: Chandler !
statements.chinese: Chandler！

statements.english: I have to tell you , you smell so smokey I have to get up
statements.chinese: 我得告诉你，你身上的烟味太重了，我不得不站起来。

statements.english: I'm not kidding
statements.chinese: 我没开玩笑。

statements.english: I think you smell great !
statements.chinese: 我觉得你闻起来很棒！

statements.english: So , we're decided
statements.chinese: 那么，我们决定了,

statements.english: no on plaid , yes on pink ?
statements.chinese: 不要格子纹，选粉色如何？
